crossRefs.note: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.
Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”
I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”
Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”
You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.
They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.
For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those…
He has brought the high fortress of your walls down, laid low, and brought to the ground, even to the dust.
Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary; and I will make Jacob a curse, and Israel an insult.”
The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!

translations.web: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.
translations.bsb: You have renounced the covenant with Your servant and sullied his crown in the dust.
translations.kjv: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.
translations.asv: Thou hast abhorred the covenant of thy servant: Thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.
